description: Poll a scan opened by zecmon_scan. Returns phase, progress and the notes found SO FAR — notes accumulate during the scan, so you can read them before it finishes. During "detecting-birthday" the response carries the descending backwards window; during "scanning" it carries birthday → tip coverage. Poll no faster than every 1.5s. Free.

includeNotes.description: Include the per-note breakdown. Default true; set false for progress only.

jobToken.description: From zecmon_scan — the only credential for this job.
